name: HONEYMOON BRIDGE
description: Bridge with Semi-Exposed Dummies (also known as Honeymoon Bridge variant) is a two-player adaptation of Contract Bridge. It solves the issue of missing players by using two 'Semi-Exposed' hands on the table. Each dummy consists of stacks of cards where only the top card is visible. As cards are played, the hidden cards underneath are revealed. This creates a strategic duel where players must manage their own hand while navigating the unknown elements of the table dummies.

content.text: Bridge with Semi-Exposed Dummies (also known as Honeymoon Bridge variant) is a two-player adaptation of Contract Bridge. It solves the issue of missing players by using two 'Semi-Exposed' hands on the table. Each dummy consists of stacks of cards where only the top card is visible. As cards are played, the hidden cards underneath are revealed. This creates a strategic duel where players must manage their own hand while navigating the unknown elements of the table dummies.
Developed as a 'Honeymoon' Bridge variant to allow two players to enjoy the strategic complexity of Bridge without a full table. It borrows the 'uncovering' mechanic from games like German Whist.
Each player receives 13 cards in hand. Two dummy hands of 13 cards each are dealt to the table in stacks: 6 face-down cards each covered by a face-up card, with one extra face-up card.

items.text: Full Exposed Dummy: All 13 cards of the dummies are dealt face-up immediately, making it a game of perfect information.
